advisor.sub: Not a dashboard. Every item below says what it is costing you, why it happened, the exact steps to fix it on the screens in this system, and who should do it. Ordered by money, because twelve small problems matter less than one large one. Nothing here changes anything on its own.
collapsibles: Money Finished work you have never asked to be paid for 103 records · About ₹4,436,000 of work is done, closed, and on no invoice. The oldest finished 19 days ago.
Speed Leads going cold 1 record · ₹450,000 of early pipeline is past its stage service level or overdue a follow-up.
Speed Deals that have stopped moving 1 record · ₹283,200 of pipeline (₹184,080 weighted) has sat longer than its stage allows.
Speed Deals won where nobody raised the order 1 record · ₹177,000 of business is won and has not started. The customer is waiting and does not know why.
Speed Inquiries waiting for a quotation 1 record · 1 customer inquiry has sat open past the 7-day response service level with no quotation raised.

Risk Work ordered against no quotation 158 records · 158 orders carry no link to what was quoted. Nobody can check the rate that was agreed, so the invoice is argued about after the work is done rather than before.

Risk Work closed with no report on file 100 records · 100 closed jobs have no report linked. What the customer was actually sent is not in the system, so it cannot be produced in a dispute or an assessment.

Data quality Customers you have worked for who cannot be invoiced 1 record · 1 active customers with work on file have neither a GSTIN nor a state. An invoice to them will be refused at the point of issue, because whether the tax is IGST or CGST+SGST cannot be decided without one of the two.
